title: SPyCE: Skill-Policy Co-evolution for Multimodal Agents
abstract: arXiv:2607.13854v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal agents that think with images iteratively manipulate visual evidence and invoke tools across many steps. Existing reinforcement learning methods reduce trajectories to scalar rewards, forcing the policy to discover reusable tool-use patterns from scratch on every new task; memory-based alternatives retain past experience, yet they rely on test-time retrieval, without updating the policy to absorb reusable patterns from that experience. Our key insight is that multimodal reasoning trajectories should be distilled into reusable skills that co-evolve with the policy during training, rather than being consumed as rewards or retrieved from a static store. To this end, we propose SPyCE (Skill-Policy Co-evolution), a framework that distills trajectories into a hierarchical skill library and updates it throughout reinforcement learning. Execution skills capture local visual operations, while workflow skills encode high-level prior

translated_title: SPyCE：多模态智能体的技能-策略协同进化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.13854v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：通过图像进行思考的多模态智能体在多个步骤中迭代地操作视觉证据并调用工具。现有的强化学习方法将轨迹简化为标量奖励，迫使策略在每个新任务上从头开始发现可复用的工具使用模式；基于记忆的替代方案保留过往经验，但依赖测试时的检索，而不更新策略以吸收这些经验中的可复用模式。我们的关键见解是，多模态推理轨迹应被提炼为可复用的技能，并在训练过程中与策略协同进化，而不是作为奖励被消耗或从静态存储中检索。为此，我们提出SPyCE（技能-策略协同进化），一个将轨迹提炼为层级技能库并在强化学习过程中持续更新的框架。执行技能捕获局部视觉操作，而工作流技能编码高层先验。
tldr: SPyCE通过将多模态推理轨迹动态提炼为层级技能库，并与策略在训练中协同进化，从而替代传统奖励或静态检索，提升多模态智能体的可复用性和适应能力。
en_tdlr: SPyCE dynamically distills multimodal reasoning trajectories into a hierarchical skill library that co-evolves with the policy during training, replacing rewards or static retrieval to enhance reusability and adaptability of multimodal agents.
